probes.scenario: Given a new account A When 100 is deposited Then the deposit is accepted and A's balance is 100
Given account A with balance 1000 When 100 is withdrawn Then the withdrawal is accepted and A's balance drops by at least 100
Given account A When deposits of -5 and 0 are attempted Then both are rejected and A's balance stays 0
Given A with balance 100 and B with 0 When 40 is transferred from A to B Then A has 60 and B has 40
Given A with balance 100 When 10 is transferred from A to A Then the transfer is rejected and nothing is recorded for it
Given account A When 100 is deposited with txn t1 Then A's history contains an entry for t1
Given account A When a deposit of 100 with txn t1 is submitted twice Then the balance is 100 and history holds one t1 entry
Given account A When 0.1 and then 0.2 are deposited Then the balance is exactly 0.3 (no floating-point drift)
Given accounts A and B When 0.125 is deposited to A and 1.005 to B Then balances are 0.13 and 1.01 (halves away from zero)
Given A and B each with 1000 When A withdraws 10 (1% = 0.10, below minimum) and B withdraws 200 (1% = 2.00) Then A has 989.50 and B has 798
Given A with 1000 When 100 is withdrawn (fee 1.00) Then history has a withdrawal entry of 100 and a separate fee entry of 1
Given accounts A and B When A receives 0.25 foreign at rate 0.5 (0.125) and B receives 0.75 at rate 0.5 (0.375) Then balances are 0.12 and 0.38 (halves to even)
Given A with balance 1000 When interest at 10% annual is credited for 73 days Then 20 is credited (1000 * 0.10 * 73/365) and balance is 1020
Given A with 90 and recipients B, C, D When 90 is split from A to B, C, D Then each recipient gets 30 and A has 0
